title: AI Product Builder - BeReal
description: About Voodoo Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1,000 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz. About BeReal At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 100+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions. Role We're hiring a new kind of product talent: one person who owns the full product loop, from user insight to shipped features to measured impact, using AI to build. You'll own a product area and a key metric, with senior engineers shipping your prototypes. Talk to users and dig into the data to find what to build next. Set the strategy: hypotheses, priorities, what to build or kill. Build and ship features yourself with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex…). Instrument your features, build data dashboards and run A/B tests. Own the results and iterate fast. Profile You're a builder: a technical PM who ships with AI, a product engineer with strong product sense, or a former founder. You have a sharp product intuition for consumer apps (social is a plus). You're hyper analytical: funnels, cohorts, experimentation. You ship working software with AI and understand tech well enough to work with senior engineers. You're fast, autonomous and take full ownership. You're fluent in English (French is a plus). Benefits Competitive salary based on experience Swile Lunch voucher Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo) Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family Wellness activities in our Paris office Remote days on Fridays Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
